items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: No, I played a...one...a couple of shows with her. I played one at the Grand Theatre on 31st and State.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear Ma Rainey in those days?
Oh, yeah, I heard Ma Rainey. In fact, it was I worked with her later on here. Well, you worked with her? A couple of days.
Did you travel with her show? Did she have a show?
